facts.text: Cedric's signed promissory note obliges him to pay the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure (three-quarters price) once the caravans flow again and he can truck the goods to town.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note was pledged to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda on unstated terms, so how much of it still belongs to the party is unclear.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment out of Cedric's promissory note for joining the party; the share and terms were never stated.
facts.uncertain_reason: Play never stated how much of the note was promised to Malzazarik and Lady Hilda or when they are to be paid.
